│      # will enforce time‑outs.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│      if p.netloc == "":            # relative URLs are rejected                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          raise ValueError("Relative URLs not allowed")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      return url                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  *Key points*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  * **Never** use the raw `url` string to open a file – `Path(url)` is a classic RCE vector.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│  * Resolve only **after** you have stripped the unwanted prefix (e.g., `file://`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│  * Enforce a **sandbox root** for any `file://` usage and mount it read‑only/noexec.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ### 3.2 Network Fetch – Timeout & Size Guard                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ```python                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  import asyncio                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  import aiohttp                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  MAX_REDIRECTS = 5                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│  REQUEST_TIMEOUT = aiohttp.ClientTimeout(total=10)   # 10 s total                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│  MAX_RESPONSE_SIZE = 50 * 1024 * 1024                # 50 MiB                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  async def fetch(url: str) -> bytes:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│      async with aiohttp.ClientSession(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│              timeout=REQUEST_TIMEOUT,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│              connector=aiohttp.TCPConnector(limit=2,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                             ssl=False,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                             max_redirects=MAX_REDIRECTS)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      ) as sess:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          async with sess.get(url, allow_redirects=True) as resp:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│              if resp.status != 200:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                  raise RuntimeError(f"Bad status {resp.status}")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│              # Stream with a size guard                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│              total = 0                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│              data = []                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│              async for chunk in resp.content.iter_chunked(1024 * 1024):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                  total += len(chunk)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                  if total > MAX_RESPONSE_SIZE:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                      raise ValueError("Response exceeds 50 MiB")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                  data.append(chunk)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│              return b"".join(data)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  *Why* – Even if a malicious site decides to stream a 5 GB body, the guard will abort long before the process runs out of RAM.                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ### 3.3 Per‑Request, No‑Name Temporary Files                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ```python                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  import tempfile, uuid, os                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  def make_temp_blob(data: bytes) -> Path:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│      # Create a *directory* that lives only for this request                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      tmp_dir = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="rapp_", dir="/dev/shm"))                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│      # The directory itself is not readable by anybody else                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│      os.chmod(tmp_dir, 0o700)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      blob = tmp_dir / f"payload-{uuid.uuid4().hex}"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│      blob.write_bytes(data)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│      return blob                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  *Guardrails*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  * **Never** use the original URL's filename (`blob = Path(temp_dir, url.split('/')[-1])`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│  * The directory is **separate** for each coroutine – if the process crashes the whole FD tree is torn down.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  * The directory lives on an in‑memory, **noexec** mount (`/dev/shm`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ### 3.4 Loader – Use Pure‑Python Whenever Possible                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  | Source | Current (risk) | Preferred (safe) |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  |--------|----------------|------------------|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  | PDF → PDFMiner / pdfminer.six | External poppler may spawn a subprocess | Pure‑Python parsing |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│  | Image → OpenCV / Pillow | Needs native libs but safe when run as a non‑privileged user | Pillow (Image.open) – no external binaries |                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│  | OCR fallback → pytesseract | Calls `tesseract` binary | Use `EasyOCR` (torch) *or* a small on‑device model (ONNX) |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  **Example** – Replace the `pdfminer` block with **`pdfminer.six`**:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ```python                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  from pdfminer.high_level import extract_text                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  def extract_pdf_text(tmp_path: Path) -> str:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│      return extract_text(str(tmp_path))                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  *Outcome* – No `subprocess.Popen`, no risk of malicious `xpdf` command injection.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ### 3.5 Vector‑Store Isolation & Encryption                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  1. **Run the store directory on a read‑only bind‑mount** inside the container:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│     ```dockerfile                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│     VOLUME ["/app/vector_store"]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│     RUN mkdir -p /app/vector_store && chmod 600 /app/vector_store                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│     ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│  2. **Encrypt at rest** – for Chroma you can set `chroma.db` inside a directory opened with `sqlcipher`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│  3. **Never log** the raw document text; log only a SHA‑256 hash and the source URL.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│     ```python                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│     import hashlib                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│     digest = hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│     logger.info(f"doc_id={doc_id} src={url} sha256={digest}")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│     ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ### 3.6 Dependency Management                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  * Pin **exact** versions in `requirements.txt` (or `poetry.lock`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│  * Run **`safety`** and **`bandit`** nightly in CI.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│  * Prefer wheels compiled on the **same platform** to avoid “manylinux” tricks.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ```txt                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│  # Example pinned list                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  aiohttp==3.9.5                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  pdfminer.six==20231228                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│  pillow==10.2.0                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  # No “poppler” package – we avoid external binaries                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ### 3.7 Concurrency Guardrails                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ```python                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  MAX_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS = 8   # OS‑level limit (ulimit -n) for file descriptors                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  semaphore = asyncio.Semaphore(MAX_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  async def handle_one(req):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│      async with semaphore:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│          # All the safe helpers above are called here                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│          ...                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  *Add a watchdog* (e.g., `prometheus_client`) that raises an alert if a request stays open > 9 seconds.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ## 4️⃣  Automated Test Suite (minimum 80 % coverage)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  | Test | What it validates | Suggested Tool |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│  |------|-------------------|----------------|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│  | **`test_valid_scheme_rejects_others`** | Rejects `data:`, `javascript:` etc. | pytest + parametrize |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│  | **`test_url_canonicalisation_no_path_traversal`** | Ensures `../../etc/passwd` cannot be read via `file://`. | file I/O in a sandboxed temp dir |                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│  | **`test_fetch_body_limit`** | Fetches a 60 MiB payload – expects `ValueError`. | aiohttp test client mock |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│  | **`test_temp_file_isolation`** | Two concurrent requests create sibling dirs; each should not see the other’s files. | `subprocess` + `psutil` |                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│  | **`test_pdf_parse_without_external_binary`** | Calls `extract_pdf_text` on a crafted PDF – ensure no `os.system` call appears in test coverage trace. | `coverage` + `bandit` |                                                                                                                                                                     │
│  | **`test_vector_store_encrypts_at_rest`** | Reads the on‑disk DB file and verifies it is not plain text (e.g., `strings` shows gibberish). | `subprocess.run(['strings'], capture_output=True)` |                                                                                                                                                    │
│  | **`test_concurrency_limit`** | Starts 50 concurrent requests; asserts `ulimit -n` not exceeded and no `OSError: Too many open files`. | pytest‑asyncio + `psutil` |                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  | **`test_no_dependencies_with_known_cves`** | Runs `safety check -r requirements.txt --full-report`. | `safety` as a pre‑commit hook |                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  All tests must run **inside the same container image** you ship to production. The CI should fail the build if any test exceeds a 2 second runtime—this keeps “slow attacks” (e.g., deliberate 10 s fetches) from slipping through.                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ## 5️⃣  10‑Item Hardening Checklist (copy‑paste into a markdown checklist)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│  - [ ] URL validation uses `safe_url()` (scheme whitelist, sandbox for file://)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  - [ ] Network fetches enforce <10 s overall timeout & <50 MiB max payload                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  - [ ] Each request creates a fresh temp directory under /dev/shm (chmod 700)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  - [ ] Temporary blobs get a **uuid‑based**, non‑guessable filename                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│  - [ ] PDFs are parsed with pdfminer.six (no subprocess call)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  - [ ] Image OCR uses a pure‑Python OCR library; poppler/tesseract are NOT installed                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│  - [ ] Vector‑store directory is mount‑read‑only, permissions 600, encrypted at rest                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│  - [ ] All logs contain only SHA‑256 of the document, not the raw text                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  - [ ] Dependency list is fully pinned and passes `safety` nightly                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│  - [ ] All above are covered by at least one pytest in CI (run on every PR)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│  - [ ] Container runs as non‑root user (UID 1000+) and has `noexec` on /dev/shm                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  Running this checklist **before every release** will catch the most common regression (e.g., a developer re‑introduces `poppler` by adding `pdf2image`).                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ## 6️⃣  Next Steps for You                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  1. **Audit your current codebase** against the snippets above.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│     *Mark every place where you see a violation (e.g., `tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=url.split('/')[-1])`) and fix it with a temporary directory.*                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  2. **Spin a minimal sandbox container** that has only the “allowed” packages.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│     ```Dockerfile                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│     FROM python:3.12-slim                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│     RUN useradd -u 1000 appuser                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│     WORKDIR /app                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│     COPY requirements.txt .                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│     RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│     COPY . .                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│     USER appuser                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│     CMD ["python", "-m", "uvicorn", "myapp:app", "--port", "8080"]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│     ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│     Run `docker run --read-only` to guarantee the read‑only FS you’ll need.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  3. **Add the test suite to your CI** (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI…) and set the pipeline to **fail on any security‑scan alert**.                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  4. **Do a “red‑team” run** – let a colleague try to break the service using tools like `ffuf` for URL fuzzing, `cURL` with `--max-filesize`, and `python:curl` for giant PDFs. Record the exact points where the checks stopped the attack and tighten the bounds if needed.                                                                          │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  5. **Document the policy**:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│     *All future developers must get a signed “security brief” that they have read the 10‑item checklist.*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ### TL;DR                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  *Validate every inbound URL, strip everything that looks like a file path.*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  *Never fetch > 50 MiB or wait > 10 s.*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│  *Use a per‑request temp dir on an in‑memory, no‑exec mount, with a UUID name.*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  *Parse PDFs with a pure‑Python engine; drop poppler/tesseract.*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│  *Encrypt and readonly‑mount the index, and log only hashes.*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  *Pin dependencies, run static analysis, and have a full test‑suite that tries to break each guard.*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  If you adopt this checklist, you’ll have **defense‑in‑depth** that stops the three most common attack patterns (path traversal, oversized payload DoS, and RCE via external libraries) while keeping the service fast and developer‑friendly.                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  Happy hardening! 🚀                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │

│  *Feel free to copy the code blocks into your repo, adjust the `sandbox` root for your `file://` usage, and let me know if you need a **Docker‑Compose** version that wires everything together.*                                                                                                                                                      │

│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  class DocumentQueryStore:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│      """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      FAISS Store for document query results.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      Manages documents identified by URI for storage, retrieval, and searching.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # Default chunking parameters                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      DEFAULT_CHUNK_SIZE = 1000                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│      DEFAULT_CHUNK_OVERLAP = 100                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # Cache for initialized stores                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│      _stores: dict[str, "DocumentQueryStore"] = {}                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      @staticmethod                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      def get(agent: Agent):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│          """Create a DocumentQueryStore instance for the specified agent."""                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          if not agent or not agent.config:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
