│          await self.agent.handle_intervention()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          exists = await self.store.document_exists(document_uri_norm)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│          document_content = ""                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│          if not exists:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│              await self.agent.handle_intervention()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│              if mimetype.startswith("image/"):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                  document_content = self.handle_image_document(document_uri, scheme)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│              elif mimetype == "text/html":                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                  document_content = self.handle_html_document(document_uri, scheme)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│              elif mimetype.startswith("text/") or mimetype == "application/json":                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                  document_content = self.handle_text_document(document_uri, scheme)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│              elif mimetype == "application/pdf":                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                  document_content = self.handle_pdf_document(document_uri, scheme)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│              else:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                  document_content = self.handle_unstructured_document(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                      document_uri, scheme                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                  )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│              if add_to_db:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                  self.progress_callback(f"Indexing document")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│                  await self.agent.handle_intervention()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                  async with self.store_lock:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                      success, ids = await self.store.add_document(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                          document_content, document_uri_norm                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                      )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                  if not success:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                      self.progress_callback(f"Failed to index document")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                      raise ValueError(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                          f"DocumentQueryHelper::document_get_content: Failed to index document: {document_uri_norm}"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                      )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                  self.progress_callback(f"Indexed {len(ids)} chunks")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│          else:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              await self.agent.handle_intervention()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│              doc = await self.store.get_document(document_uri_norm)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│              if doc:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                  document_content = doc.page_content                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│              else:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                  raise ValueError(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                      f"DocumentQueryHelper::document_get_content: Document not found: {document_uri_norm}"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                  )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│          return document_content                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      def handle_image_document(self, document: str, scheme: str) -> str:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│          return self.handle_unstructured_document(document, scheme)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      def handle_html_document(self, document: str, scheme: str) -> str:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│          if scheme in ["http", "https"]:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│              loader = AsyncHtmlLoader(web_path=document)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│              parts: list[Document] = loader.load()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│          elif scheme == "file":                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              # Use RFC file operations instead of TextLoader                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              file_content_bytes = files.read_file_bin(document)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              file_content = file_content_bytes.decode("utf-8")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              # Create Document manually since we're not using TextLoader                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│              parts = [Document(page_content=file_content, metadata={"source": document})]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│          else:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              raise ValueError(f"Unsupported scheme: {scheme}")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          return "\n".join(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│              [                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                  element.page_content                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│                  for element in MarkdownifyTransformer().transform_documents(parts)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│              ]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│          )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      def handle_text_document(self, document: str, scheme: str) -> str:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│          if scheme in ["http", "https"]:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│              loader = AsyncHtmlLoader(web_path=document)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│              elements: list[Document] = loader.load()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│          elif scheme == "file":                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              # Use RFC file operations instead of TextLoader                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              file_content_bytes = files.read_file_bin(document)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              file_content = file_content_bytes.decode("utf-8")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              # Create Document manually since we're not using TextLoader                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│              elements = [                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                  Document(page_content=file_content, metadata={"source": document})                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│              ]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│          else:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              raise ValueError(f"Unsupported scheme: {scheme}")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          return "\n".join([element.page_content for element in elements])                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      def handle_pdf_document(self, document: str, scheme: str) -> str:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│          temp_file_path = ""                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          if scheme == "file":                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│              # Use RFC file operations to read the PDF file as binary                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│              file_content_bytes = files.read_file_bin(document)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              # Create a temporary file for PyMuPDFLoader since it needs a file path                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│              import tempfile                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False, suffix=".pdf") as temp_file:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                  temp_file.write(file_content_bytes)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                  temp_file_path = temp_file.name                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│          elif scheme in ["http", "https"]:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│              # download the file from the web url to a temporary file using python libraries for downloading                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              import requests                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              import tempfile                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │

│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │

│              except Exception as e:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │

│              if not contents:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│                  import pdf2image                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                  import pytesseract                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │

│                  for page in pages:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │

│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      def handle_unstructured_document(self, document: str, scheme: str) -> str:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │

│              raise ValueError(f"Unsupported scheme: {scheme}")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │

│  ## Secure‑by‑Design Blueprint for the “Document‑to‑Vector” Service                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  Below is a **complete, copy‑‑and‑‑pasteable** set of artefacts you can drop into your repo and CI pipeline.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  It covers **every attack surface** that a typical implementation touches, shows **minimal‑risk replacements**, and gives you a **hardening checklist + automated test suite** so the safeguards never regress.                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │

│  ### 1.   Architecture Overview (what you’re protecting)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│  +----------------+   HTTP  +--------------------+   File I/O   +-------------------+                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│  |  Client/API    | ----->  |  FastAPI / UVicorn | ───►  /tmp/   |  Temporary blobs  |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  +----------------+          +--------------------+            +-------------------+                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│           |                                 |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│           |  (validate URL, fetch)         |  (pure‑python parsers)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│           ▼                                 ▼                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  +----------------+                    +----------------+                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│  |  Remote store  |   (optional)  ►────► |  Vector store  |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│  |  (S3, DB, …)  |   read‑only   |  (Chroma, FAISS)|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│  +----------------+                +----------------+                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  **Key security boundaries**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  | Boundary | Goal |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│  |----------|------|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│  | **Incoming URL** | Reject unsafe schemes, stop path‑traversal. |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│  | **Network fetch** | Enforce strict size / time limits. |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│  | **Temporary storage** | No file leakage, no exec, unpredictable names. |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│  | **Document parsing** | No external binaries (poppler, tesseract). |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  | **Vector store** | Read‑only mount, encrypt at rest, never log raw text. |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  | **Dependencies** | Fully pinned, scanned for CVEs. |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ### 2.   URL‑Validation & Sanitisation                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  > **Never trust the client**. Use the helper `safe_url()` in **all** request handlers.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ```python                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  # utils/security.py                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│  import re                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  import urllib.parse                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│  from pathlib import Path                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│  from typing import Tuple                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  # ------------------------------------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│  # 1. Whitelist of allowed schemes (http/https and file only)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  ALLOWED_SCHEMES = {"http", "https", "file"}                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  # 2. Disallow data:, javascript:, etc.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│  FORBIDDEN_PREFIX = re.compile(r"""^(data|javascript|about):""", re.I)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  def _parse(url: str) -> urllib.parse.ParseResult:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      return urllib.parse.urlparse(url)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  def _is_safe_scheme(parcel: urllib.parse.ParseResult) -> bool:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      return parcel.scheme.lower() in ALLOWED_SCHEMES                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  def _check_forbidden_prefix(url: str) -> bool:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      return bool(FORBIDDEN_PREFIX.match(url))                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  # ------------------------------------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│  # Public entry point                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│  def safe_url(url: str, sandbox_root: Path | None = None) -> Tuple[str, str]:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│      """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      Validate ``url`` and optionally resolve a ``file://`` path to a sandboxed                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│      directory.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      Returns (canonical_url, resolved_path). ``resolved_path`` is only                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      populated for ``file://`` URLs and MUST be used for all subsequent                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      filesystem work.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      Raises:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          ValueError – if the URL is rejected.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│      """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      # 1️⃣ Basic split                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│      p = _parse(url)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # 2️⃣ Scheme whitelist                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│      if not _is_safe_scheme(p):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          raise ValueError(f"disallowed scheme: {p.scheme}")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # 3️⃣ Disallow obvious dangerous prefixes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│      if _check_forbidden_prefix(url):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│          raise ValueError("URL uses a forbidden prefix")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # 4️⃣ Special handling for file://                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      if p.scheme == "file":                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│          # Decode %,/ etc. and map to a *sandbox* directory                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│          try:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│              raw_path = urllib.parse.unquote(p.path, errors="strict")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│          except Exception as exc:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│              raise ValueError(f"malformed file:// path: {exc}")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          # OPTIONAL: you can force every file:// to resolve under a sandbox                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│          if sandbox_root is not None:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│              raw_path = raw_path.lstrip("/")  # strip leading slash                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│              if ".." in raw_path or raw_path.startswith("/"):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│                  raise ValueError("attempted directory traversal in file://")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│              # Resolve safely inside the sandbox_root                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│              sandboxed = (sandbox_root / raw_path).resolve()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              if not str(sandboxed).startswith(str(sandbox_root.resolve())):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│                  raise ValueError("path traversal blocked")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│              return url, str(sandboxed)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│          else:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              # If you *don't* want a sandbox, just check the path is absolute                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│              Path(raw_path).resolve().absolute()  # will raise if weird                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # 5️⃣ All good – return the canonical URL (helps with idempotency)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      return f"{p.scheme}://{p.netloc}{p.path}".rstrip("/") or url[:1] + "://"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  **How to use it in a FastAPI endpoint**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ```python                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Request                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│  from pathlib import Path                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│  from utils.security import safe_url                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  app = FastAPI()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│  SANDBOX_ROOT = Path("/dev/shm/app_tmp")   # mount is noexec, 700 perms                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  @app.post("/extract")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  async def extract_doc(request: Request):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│      payload = await request.json()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
