│      raw_url = payload["url"]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│      doc_id = payload.get("id", str(uuid.uuid4()))                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      try:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│          canonical, resolved_path = safe_url(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│              raw_url,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│              sandbox_root=SANDBOX_ROOT,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│          )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│      except ValueError as e:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(e))                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # --------------------------------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│      # 2️⃣ Fetch remote content (size / time limited)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│      content_bytes = await fetch_with_limits(canonical, max_bytes=50 * 1024 * 1024,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                                              timeout=10)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # 3️⃣ Store into a per‑request temp dir (see §3)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│      tmp_dir = await create_isolated_tmp_dir()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│      blob_path = tmp_dir / "blob.bin"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      async with aiofiles.open(blob_path, "wb") as f:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│          await f.write(content_bytes)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # 4️⃣ Parse (pure‑python) … see §4                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      text, meta = await parse_document(blob_path, doc_id)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # 5️⃣ Vectorise, persist to read‑only store …                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│      await persist_vectors(meta, text)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # 6️⃣ Log **only** a hash, not the raw text                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      sha256 = hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      logger.info(f"doc_id={doc_id} src={canonical} sha256={sha256}")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      return {"doc_id": doc_id, "status": "ok"}                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ### 3.   Isolated Temporary Storage (no race, no exec)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  *Mounted on an in‑memory, **noexec**, 0700 directory (e.g. `/dev/shm/app_tmp`).*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ```python                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  # utils/tmp.py                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  import asyncio                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  import os                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  import uuid                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  import tempfile                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│  from pathlib import Path                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  # Ensure the directory exists at container start‑up (Dockerfile should do it)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│  SANDBOX_ROOT = Path("/dev/shm/app_tmp")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  async def create_isolated_tmp_dir() -> Path:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│      """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      Returns a brand‑new, non‑guessable, non‑executable directory.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      The caller must clean it up (or the container will prune /dev/shm on exit).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│      """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      # Random UUID + timestamp for good measure                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      dir_name = f"req-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│      dir_path = (SANDBOX_ROOT / dir_name).resolve()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│      # The mode 0o700 guarantees only the owner can list/read/write                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│      dir_path.mkdir(parents=True, mode=0o700)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # Store the path in the event loop – we close at the end of request                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      return dir_path                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  **Why not `tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=url.split('/')[-1])`?**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  * `suffix` is predictable → possible symlink/guessing attacks.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  * The temporary file lives **outside** the sandbox → accidental leakage if another process can read it.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ### 4.   Document Parsing – *Pure‑Python Only*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  | Original (risky) | Secure Replacement (pure‑python) |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│  |------------------|-----------------------------------|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│  | `pdfminer.six` with external C bindings, or a call to `pdftotext` (Ghostscript). | `pdfplumber` (pure‑Python) **or** `PyMuPDF` (fitz) – both are 100 % Python wheels. |                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  | OCR with `tesseract` (native binary). | `ocrmypdf` (pip) uses `tesseract` **if available**, but you should disable OCR entirely or replace it with `EasyOCR` (pure‑torch, no system deps). |                                                                                                                                                        │
│  | External image decoding → `Image.open(...)` (PIL) – still safe *if* you only use the pure‑Python wheel. | **Same**; make sure you install Pillow from PyPI (not system `libjpeg`). |                                                                                                                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  #### Example: 100 % Python PDF → Text                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ```python                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  # utils/parse.py                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│  from typing import Tuple                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│  import logging                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  import hashlib                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  LOGGER = logging.getLogger(__name__)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  def pdf_to_text(path: Path) -> str:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│      """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      Pure‑Python conversion using ``pdfplumber`` (pip package: pdfplumber==0.12.0)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      Install with ``pip install pdfplumber``. No native libs are required.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│      """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      import pdfplumber  # imported lazily – will raise ImportError if missing                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│      with pdfplumber.open(str(path)) as pdf:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          # Concatenate each page's extracted text                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│          pages = [page.extract_text() or "" for page in pdf.pages]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      return "\n".join(pages).strip()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  def ocr_image_to_text(path: Path) -> str:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│      """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      If OCR is really needed, use EasyOCR (pip install easyocr). It ships Torch                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      wheels without system dependencies on Linux.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│      """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      import easyocr                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│      reader = easyocr.Reader(['en'], gpu=False)   # gpu=False → pure‑torch, no CUDA                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│      result = reader.readtext(str(path), detail=0)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      return "\n".join(result)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  async def parse_document(blob_path: Path, doc_id: str) -> Tuple[str, dict]:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      Detect file type and delegate to the right pure‑python extractor.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      Returns (content_text, meta_dict) where meta contains size, page‑count, etc.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│      """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      import magic  # python-magic (libmagic wrapper) – pure‑python wheel                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      mgr = magic.Magic()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      mime = mgr.from_file(str(blob_path))                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      meta = {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│          "doc_id": doc_id,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│          "size": blob_path.stat().st_size,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│          "mime": mime,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      if mime.startswith("application/pdf"):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│          text = pdf_to_text(blob_path)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│          meta["pages"] = text.count("\f") + 1   # crude page estimate                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│      elif mime.startswith("image/"):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│          # Fallback OCR if needed; otherwise raise                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│          if "OCR_NEEDED" in meta:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│              text = ocr_image_to_text(blob_path)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│          else:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              raise ValueError("image document needs OCR – not configured")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│      else:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│          raise ValueError(f"Unsupported MIME type: {mime}")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      return text, meta                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  **Result:** No calls to `pdftotext`, `ghostscript`, or `tesseract`. All heavy lifting is done by pip wheels that come pre‑compiled for the platform.                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ### 5.   Vector Store – Read‑Only, Encrypted, Never Logged                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  1. **Mount the vector DB as a read‑only bind‑mount** (e.g., inside Docker you can use `--read-only` + a separate volume for the DB that receives writes **only** from the *loader* process, which you can lock down to a different user).                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│     ```dockerfile                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│     # Dockerfile snippet                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│     VOLUME /vectors                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│     RUN mkdir -p /vectors && chmod 0755 /vectors                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│     # The container runs as non‑root user (e.g. appuser)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│     USER appuser                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│     ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  2. **Never log raw embeddings** – only log a deterministic hash of the document’s fingerprint (e.g., SHA‑256 of the document bytes + timestamp).                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│     ```python                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│     def hash_fingerprint(text: str, doc_id: str) -> str:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│         h = hashlib.sha256()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│         h.update((text + doc_id).encode())                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│         return h.hexdigest()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│     logger.debug(f"fingerprint={hash_fingerprint(text, doc_id)}")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│     ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  3. **Encrypt at rest** – if you use a DB (Postgres + `pgcrypto`) or a file‑based store (FAISS index), keep a key in an environment variable injected by the orchestrator (e.g., Kubernetes `Secret`).                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ### 6.   Dependency Hygiene                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ```yaml                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│  # requirements.txt (or Pipfile, poetry.lock)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  pdfplumber==0.12.0                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│  easyocr==1.7.6                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  pdf2image==1.16.3          # if you ever need to render pages – still pure‑Python                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│  python-magic==0.4.27                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│  fastapi==0.112.0                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│  uvicorn[standard]==0.30.0                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  aiofiles==23.2.1                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│  uuid==1.30        # stdlib, but pinned for reproducibility                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  **Automated CVE scanning**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ```bash                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│  # Add a step to your CI (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, etc.)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  # Example for GitHub Actions:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│  - name: Install dependencies                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│    run: |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│      pip install pip-tools twine                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│      pip-compile --resolver=lcm -U                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      pip install -r requirements.txt                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│  - name: Scan for known vulnerabilities                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│    uses: pypa/gh-action-pip-audit@master                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│    with:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      requirements: requirements.txt                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│      fail-hard: true                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  **If a scanner finds a vulnerability with a “no‑source” package (e.g., a compiled wheel), replace it with a pure‑Python alternative or upgrade to the newest version.**                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ### 7.   Concurrency & Rate‑Limiting                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  | Concern | Mitigation |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│  |--------|------------|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│  | **Unbounded parallel fetches** (e.g., a client sends 100 URLs) | Use an `asyncio.Semaphore(max_concurrent=10)` (or similar) around the `fetch_with_limits` coroutine. |                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  | **DoS via huge documents** | In `fetch_with_limits`, always read the **Response header `Content-Length`** and also enforce an absolute cap (e.g., 50 MiB). |                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  | **Malicious client exhausting the temp‑dir quota** | Since the temp dir lives on a tmpfs (`/dev/shm`) you can set a global memory limit in Docker (`--shm-size=256m`) and watch the process exit when the container dies. |                                                                                                                         │
│  | **Resource leaks** | Wrap each request in a *request‑lifetime* context manager that cleans the temporary directory in a `finally:` block. |                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ```python                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  # fastapi dependency that caps concurrency                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│  concurrency_sema = asyncio.Semaphore(10)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  @app.post("/extract")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  async def extract_doc(request: Request, background_tasks: BackgroundTasks):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      async with concurrency_sema:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│          # normal extraction logic (see §2) …                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│          # Register cleanup of temporary directory at the end of request:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│          background_tasks.add_task(cleanup_tmp_dir, tmp_dir)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      return {"status":"ok"}                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
