│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  def cleanup_tmp_dir(dir_path: Path):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│      try:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│          for p in dir_path.rglob("*"):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│              p.unlink()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│          dir_path.rmdir()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│      except Exception:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│          pass   # ignore errors – the request already succeeded                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ### 8.   Automated Test Suite (pytest)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  All critical paths are covered by **unit** and **integration** tests that run in CI.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  #### `tests/unit/test_security.py`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ```python                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  import pytest                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│  from pathlib import Path                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│  from utils.security import safe_url, SANDBOX_ROOT                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  def test_safe_file_url_inside_sandbox():                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│      url = "file:///etc/passwd"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="attempted directory traversal"):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│          safe_url(url, sandbox_root=SANDBOX_ROOT)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  def test_safe_file_url_resolved():                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│      # Create a fake file inside the sandbox for a happy path                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│      test_file = SANDBOX_ROOT / "doc123.bin"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      test_file.touch()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      url = "file://doc123.bin"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│      canon, resolved = safe_url(url, sandbox_root=SANDBOX_ROOT)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      assert canon == "file://doc123.bin"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      assert resolved == str(test_file.resolve())                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  #### `tests/integration/test_extract_flow.py`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ```python                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  import asyncio                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  import json                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  import hashlib                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  import httpx                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  import pytest                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│  from httpx import AsyncClient                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│  from fastapi.testclient import TestClient                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  from app.main import app   # your FastAPI instance                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  client = AsyncClient(app=app, base_url="http://testserver")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  @pytest.fixture                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│  def dummy_pdf(tmp_path):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│      """Write a tiny PDF (just a few bytes) for the integration test."""                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      path = tmp_path / "tiny.pdf"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│      path.write_bytes(b"%PDF-1.4\n1 0 obj << /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >> endobj\nxref\ntrailer << /Size 3 >>\n%%EOF")                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      return path                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  @pytest.mark.asyncio                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│  async def test_full_extraction(dummy_pdf, monkeypatch):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      # Mock the external fetch – we want the server to read the file locally.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│      async def mocked_fetch(url, headers):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│          # The server will treat the URL "local://dummy_pdf" as a local file                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          import pathlib                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│          p = pathlib.Path(url).read_bytes()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│          return httpx.Response(200, content=p, headers=dict(content_type="application/pdf"))                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      monkeypatch.setattr("httpx.AsyncClient.get", mocked_fetch)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # The request can point to a file inside the sandbox:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│      request_url = "local://dummy_pdf"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      r = await client.post("/extract", json={"url": request_url})                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│      assert r.status_code == 200                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│      data = r.json()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│      # Verify that we got textual output, not binary garble                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│      assert "text" in data and len(data["text"]) > 0                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # Verify a fingerprint was logged                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      logged_fingerprint = data.get("fingerprint")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│      assert logged_fingerprint is not None                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│      # recompute the hash locally to ensure consistency                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      expected = hashlib.sha256((data["text"] + data["request_id"]).encode()).hexdigest()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      assert logged_fingerprint == expected                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  Running `pytest -q` should return **0 failures** when you have all the earlier pieces in place.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │

│  ### 9.   Deploy Checklist (Before you go to production)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  | ✅ Item | Why it matters |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  |--------|----------------|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  | **Run as non‑root user** (`USER appuser` in Docker) | Prevent privilege escalation if a container escape occurs. |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│  | **Read‑only filesystem for the app code** (`--read-only` + separate volume for the vector store) | Stops malware from overwriting your code. |                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│  | **Limit RAM (`--shm-size`), network throttle (`--pids-limit`), CPU (`--cpus`)** | Guarantees a single malicious request cannot starve the service. |                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│  | **Enforce HTTPS at the ingress** (TLS termination in an ALB/NGINX) | Prevents man‑in‑the‑middle on your external API. |                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  | **API key / JWT auth + rate‑limit** (`fastapi-limiter` or similar) | Blocks opportunistic abuse. |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│  | **Secrets injected via vault / k8s secrets – never hard‑coded** | Avoids accidental credential leaks. |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  | **S3 bucket / remote storage for large files (optional)** – off‑load any files > 50 MiB to a cloud bucket, then fetch via signed URL for a single short window. | Keeps your container’s memory footprint low and prevents local disk‑full attacks. |                                                                                               │
│  | **Run the dependency scanner as part of CI and block releases on findings** | Guarantees you never ship a vulnerable wheel. |                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│  | **Health endpoint that checks that the vector DB is reachable and the temp directory has < 10 MiB used** | Allows Kubernetes to auto‑restart a misbehaving pod. |                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ## TL;DR – One‑Page “What to Copy‑Paste”                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ```dockerfile                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│  # Dockerfile                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  FROM python:3.12-slim                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  # Install pure‑Python deps only (no apt packages!)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│  COPY requirements.txt .                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│  RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  # Create a non‑root user                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│  RUN useradd -m -u 1001 appuser                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  WORKDIR /app                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  COPY . .                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│  USER appuser                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  # Run the app, but the vector store lives on a read‑only bind mount                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│  EXPOSE 8000                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  CMD ["uvicorn", "app.main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000"]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│  # docker run (example)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│  docker run -d \                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│    --read-only \                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│    --tmpfs /tmp \                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│    --shm-size=256m \                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│    --network=restricted \                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│    -e VECTOR_DB_PATH=/vectors/faiss_index \                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│    -v /opt/vectors:/vectors:ro \                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│    myapp:latest                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ### Core code to copy                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  | Module | Content (copy‑paste) |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│  |--------|----------------------|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│  | `utils/security.py` | **`safe_url`** implementation with sandbox option |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  | `utils/parse.py`   | **`pdf_to_text`**, **`ocr_image_to_text`**, **`parse_document`** |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  | `utils/fetch.py`   | `async fetch_with_limits` (checks `Content‑Length`, caps at 50 MiB) |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  | `app/dependencies.py` | FastAPI **semaphore** and **request‑lifetime cleanup** |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│  | `requirements.txt` | List of **pure‑Python** wheels (see section 6) |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│  | `tests/…` | Minimal pytest suite (see section 8) |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ### Bottom Line                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  1. **Never call a native binary** (`pdftotext`, `tesseract`) – use well‑tested pure‑Python wheels.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│  2. **Isolate every request** – temporary dir, concurrency limit, read‑only filesystem, and resource caps.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  3. **Audit every third‑party import** with a CI‑side `pip-audit` step.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│  4. **Log only hashes** of sensitive data, keep the raw content off logs and off the persistent store.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  If you stitch those pieces together, you get a production‑ready extraction service that:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  - **Runs in any container (no apt‑install needed).**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│  - **Handles PDFs, images, and OCR** using only pip‑installable Python.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│  - **Cannot be tricked into executing system commands** because the process has no permission to spawn binaries or access external network sockets.                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  Feel free to cherry‑pick the snippets above, adapt the sandbox path (`/sandbox/` vs `/etc/...`) to your own security policies, and run the provided test suite in CI to lock the behaviour down.                                                                                                                                                      │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  Good luck, and happy secure hacking! 🚀                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │

│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  DEFAULT_SEARCH_THRESHOLD = 0.5                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  class DocumentQueryStore:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│      """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      FAISS Store for document query results.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      Manages documents identified by URI for storage, retrieval, and searching.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # Default chunking parameters                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      DEFAULT_CHUNK_SIZE = 1000                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│      DEFAULT_CHUNK_OVERLAP = 100                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # Cache for initialized stores                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│      _stores: dict[str, "DocumentQueryStore"] = {}                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      @staticmethod                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      def get(agent: Agent):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│          """Create a DocumentQueryStore instance for the specified agent."""                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          if not agent or not agent.config:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│              raise ValueError("Agent and agent config must be provided")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          # Initialize store                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│          store = DocumentQueryStore(agent)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│          return store                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      def __init__(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│          self,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│          agent: Agent,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      ):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│          """Initialize a DocumentQueryStore instance."""                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│          self.agent = agent                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│          self.vector_db: VectorDB | None = None                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      @staticmethod                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      def normalize_uri(uri: str) -> str:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│          """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          Normalize a document URI to ensure consistent lookup.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          Args:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              uri: The URI to normalize                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          Returns:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│              Normalized URI                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│          """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          # Convert to lowercase                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          normalized = uri.strip()  # uri.lower()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          # Parse the URL to get scheme                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│          parsed = urlparse(normalized)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│          scheme = parsed.scheme or "file"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          # Normalize based on scheme                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│          if scheme == "file":                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│              path = files.fix_dev_path(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                  normalized.removeprefix("file://").removeprefix("file:")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│              )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              normalized = f"file://{path}"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          elif scheme in ["http", "https"]:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
